content: May 27, 2026: the foundational 'soul' phase of Aiko-chan was kickstarted with a CLI-based companion integrating Qdrant’s persistent memory backend and initial NLP tooling.
May 28, 2026: the core memory layer for Aiko-chan’s cognitive loop was established using Qdrant’s vector storage, enabling persistent retrieval of search tags and prompts.
May 28, 2026: the web search tool was integrated with an auto-triggering mechanism, allowing seamless indexing and retrieval of online information within the cognitive loop.
May 29, 2026: speech synthesis and SearXNG configuration were added, enabling Aiko-chan to generate spoken responses and filter web content through a dedicated voice interaction pipeline.
May 30, 2026: a background LLM and TTS warmup system was implemented to eliminate cold-start latency, ensuring consistent performance across sessions.
May 31, 2026: identity metadata was integrated and Docker services were optimized, refining memory initialization and reducing boot-time overhead for Aiko-chan’s systems.
